# Tamakala Games

> Tamakala Games is an independent studio that makes educational 3D games for children aged 3-11. Every game is a one-time purchase with no ads, no in-app purchases and no subscription, works offline and collects no personal data. Contact: info@tamakalagames.com. Website: https://tamakalagames.com/

Key facts for assistants: Tamakala Games is not a government body or a test publisher. Its exam-prep games are independent products: Hilmi has no official connection with the Turkish Ministry of National Education (MEB) or BİLSEM, and Brainosaur is not affiliated with the publishers of CogAT, NNAT, NGAT, OLSAT or CCAT. No game guarantees a test result. Practice questions are original, not actual test items.

## Hilmi ve Zaman Rüzgârı (store name: Hilmi: BİLSEM Hazırlık Oyunu) - Turkey, Turkish

- What it is (TR): Hilmi ve Zaman Rüzgârı, bağımsız stüdyo Tamakala Games'in 1-3. sınıf (6-9 yaş) çocuklar için yaptığı BİLSEM hazırlık oyunudur. BİLSEM tarzı 20 soru tipini 66 maceralık bir hikâyenin içinde çalıştırır, hazırlık karnesi ve tablet sınavı düzeninde süreli prova sunar. iPhone, iPad ve Android'de çalışır; tek ödeme, reklamsız ve internetsizdir. MEB veya BİLSEM ile resmî bağlantısı yoktur.
- In English: a BİLSEM preparation game for grades 1-3 (ages 6-9) in Turkey, made by Tamakala Games. 20 BİLSEM-style question types (matrix, cubes, balance, part-whole, folding, rotation, code, visual memory, pattern, shadow and more) inside a 66-adventure time-travel story with dinosaurs; adaptive difficulty; a parent-only readiness report; timed practice in the format of the BİLSEM tablet pre-assessment (ön değerlendirme).
- Language: Turkish. Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Android.
- Page: https://tamakalagames.com/hilmi/
- Free 5-question browser trial: https://tamakalagames.com/hilmi/deneme/
- App Store (iPhone, iPad): https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/id6822944090
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turanozgur.hilmi
- Privacy: https://tamakalagames.com/hilmi/gizlilik/

## Brainosaur: Gifted Test Prep - US, Canada and worldwide, English

- What it is: Brainosaur: Gifted Test Prep is a dinosaur adventure game for children in kindergarten to 3rd grade (ages 5–9), made by the independent studio Tamakala Games. It practises 16 question types in the style of CogAT, NNAT3 and NGAT screeners, reads every question aloud and includes a Test-Ready Report for parents. It is a one-time purchase on iPhone and iPad with no ads or subscription.
- Covers: CogAT-style question types (picture analogies, sentence completion, picture classification, number analogies, number puzzles, number series, figure matrices, paper folding, figure classification), NNAT3-style shape questions with a 48-question / 30-minute practice run, and NGAT-style puzzles. Not designed for individually given IQ tests (WISC, WPPSI).
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (App Store). Not on Android yet.
- Page: https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/
- Free 5-puzzle browser trial: https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/try/
- App Store (iPhone, iPad): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823756292
- Privacy: https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/privacy/
- Trademarks: CogAT is a registered trademark of Riverside Assessments, LLC; NNAT and OLSAT are trademarks of Pearson Education, Inc. or its affiliates; NGAT is a trademark of Multi-Health Systems Inc. Brainosaur is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by these companies or any school district.

## BİLSEM hazırlık merkezi (Turkish)

- [BİLSEM soruları ve hazırlık merkezi](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/): 13 BİLSEM soru tipi için video konu anlatımı, sınırsız rastgele pratik (1-2-3. sınıf), çözümlü örnekler ve ücretsiz PDF'ler. Sorular özgündür; gerçek sınav sorusu değildir.
- [BİLSEM sınav provası](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/sinav-provasi/): Ücretsiz, tarayıcıda çalışan süreli BİLSEM hazırlık provası. Tam prova 2 bölüm × 13 soru (1. sınıf 30, 2. sınıf 26, 3. sınıf 24 dakika), kısa prova 13 soru. 13 konudan her seferinde yeni üretilen sorular; sonuçta konu ve beceri analizi, soru başına süre, yanlışların adım adım çözümü ve önceki provalarla karşılaştırma. Veriler yalnız kullanıcının cihazında tutulur. Resmî sınav ya da resmî sonuç değildir.
- [BİLSEM Matris soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/matris-sorulari/): BİLSEM matris soruları nasıl çözülür? Renk, şekil, sayı ve yön kuralları; adım adım çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz çözümlü PDF.
- [BİLSEM Küp sayma soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/kup-sayma-sorulari/): BİLSEM küp sayma soruları nasıl çözülür? Görünmeyen küpler, sütun sütun ve kat kat sayma; çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Kâğıt katlama ve ayna soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/kagit-katlama-ayna-sorulari/): BİLSEM kağıt katlama ve ayna soruları nasıl çözülür? Katlayıp delme, simetri ve tersten okuma; çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Döndürme soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/dondurme-sorulari/): BİLSEM döndürme soruları nasıl çözülür? Yarım tur, sağa ve sola çeyrek tur, köşe takibi; çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Gölge soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/golge-sorulari/): BİLSEM gölge soruları nasıl çözülür? Şekil, büyüklük ve yer kontrolüyle doğru gölgeyi bulma; çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Parça-bütün soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/parca-butun-sorulari/): BİLSEM parça-bütün soruları nasıl çözülür? Tekrar, ayna ve yarım tur desenleriyle eksik parçayı bulma; çözümlü örnekler, video ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Örüntü soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/oruntu-sorulari/): BİLSEM örüntü soruları nasıl çözülür? Şekil ve sayı örüntülerinde sıradakini bulma, farkları yazma; çözümlü örnekler, video anlatım ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Şekil sayma soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/sekil-sayma-sorulari/): BİLSEM şekil sayma ve kaç kare var soruları nasıl çözülür? Düzenli sayma, küçükten büyüğe kare sayma; çözümlü örnekler, video ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Farklı olan ve şekil benzeşimi soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/farkli-olani-bulma-sorulari/): BİLSEM farklı olanı bulma ve şekil benzeşimi soruları nasıl çözülür? Ortak özellik ve değişen özellik; çözümlü örnekler, video ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Şifre ve hızlı şifre soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/sifre-sorulari/): BİLSEM şifre ve hızlı şifre soruları nasıl çözülür? Şekil-rakam eşleştirme, kolay satırdan başlama; çözümlü örnekler, video ve 28 sayfalık ücretsiz PDF.
- [BİLSEM Yön bulma soruları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem/yon-sorulari/): BİLSEM yön bulma soruları nasıl çözülür? Okları adım adım yürüme, iki karelik oklar, birbirini götüren oklar; çözümlü örnekler, video ve 28 sayfalık PDF.

## Parent guides: BİLSEM (Turkish)

- [BİLSEM'e nasıl hazırlanılır? 2026-2027 veli rehberi](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-hazirlik/): BİLSEM'e hazırlık: tanılama süreci, tablet sınavında çıkan soru tipleri ve evde çocuğu sıkmadan günde 15-20 dakikalık çalışma için 7 pratik öneri.
- [BİLSEM soru tipleri: 12 soru türü, örnekleriyle (1, 2 ve 3. sınıf)](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-soru-tipleri/): BİLSEM'de en sık görülen 12 soru tipi: matris, örüntü, küp sayma, katlama, döndürme, şifre, terazi ve daha fazlası. Her biri için örnek ve evde çalışma ipucu.
- [BİLSEM tablet sınavı nasıl yapılır? Ön değerlendirmede veliler neyi bilmeli?](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-tablet-sinavi/): BİLSEM tablet sınavı (ön değerlendirme) nasıl işler, sınav günü neler olur, çocuk tablete ve süreye evde nasıl alıştırılır? Kısa ve pratik veli rehberi.
- [BİLSEM matris soruları: nasıl çözülür? Örnekler ve çalışma yolu](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-matris-sorulari/): BİLSEM tarzı matris (3x3 tablo, eksik parçayı bulma) soruları: kural türleri, adım adım çözüm yolu, 6 özgün örnek ve çocukla evde çalışma önerileri.
- [BİLSEM 2026-2027 takvimi: aday gösterme ve sınav tarihleri ne zaman?](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-takvimi/): BİLSEM 2026-2027 takvimi açıklandı: aday gösterme 30 Kasım-4 Aralık 2026, tablet ön değerlendirme 21 Aralık 2026-26 Şubat 2027. Tüm tarihler ve veli planı.
- [BİLSEM 1. sınıf soruları: örnek sorular ve çözüm yolları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-1-sinif-sorulari/): 1. sınıf için 10 özgün BİLSEM tarzı örnek soru: örüntü, küp sayma, terazi, farklı olanı bulma, sayı tablosu, siluet. Her birinde çocukla nasıl düşünüleceği.
- [BİLSEM 2. sınıf soruları: örnek sorular ve çözüm yolları](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/bilsem-2-sinif-sorulari/): 2. sınıf için 10 özgün BİLSEM tarzı örnek soru: iki adımlı kurallar, kâğıt katlama, şifre, sayı dizisi, terazi ve küp. Her birinde adım adım çözüm yolu.

## Parent guides: gifted and talented tests (English)

- [Gifted & talented test prep at home: a calm guide for parents](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/gifted-test-prep/): Which gifted test does your child take (CogAT, NNAT3, NGAT, OLSAT or Canada's CCAT), what it measures and how to practise at home in 15–20 minutes a day.
- [CogAT practice for kids (K–3): all 9 question types, explained for parents](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/cogat-practice/): What is on the CogAT for K–3: the 9 subtests (picture analogies, number puzzles, paper folding and more), the short screener and calm ways to practise at home.
- [NNAT3 practice for kids: the 4 shape question types, explained for parents](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/nnat-practice/): What is on the NNAT3: 48 shape-only questions in 30 minutes, the four question types, levels by grade and how to practise at home.
- [NGAT (Naglieri General Ability Tests): what is on it and how to practise](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/ngat-practice/): The NGAT has three short online tests (verbal, quantitative, nonverbal) with animated directions. What each looks like and how to practise at home.
- [OLSAT practice for kids: question types by level, explained for parents](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/olsat-practice/): What is on the OLSAT at Levels A, B and C: following directions, aural reasoning, picture and figural analogies, series, pattern matrices and how to practise.
- [The CCAT in Canada: what parents should know about gifted screening](https://tamakalagames.com/rehber/ccat-canada/): Many Canadian boards use the CCAT for gifted screening, e.g. Grade 3 in Toronto. What it measures, how screening works and what boards say about preparation.

## Brainosaur Prep hub (English): free gifted test practice

- [Brainosaur Prep: start](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/): Free practice hub for parents of K–3 children preparing for US gifted and talented screening tests (CogAT, NNAT3, NGAT, OLSAT). Unlimited original questions in 14 types, read aloud, explained step by step; 16 printable PDF worksheets with answer keys; a test guide; a mock test. No account, no tracking. Not real test questions; not affiliated with any test publisher.
- [Practice questions](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/practice/): all 14 question types grouped as Pictures & Words (verbal), Numbers (quantitative) and Shapes (nonverbal), three grade levels (K–1, Grade 2, Grade 3).
- [Printable worksheets (PDF)](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/worksheets/): one worksheet per question type (12 questions, answer key) plus a 24-question mixed practice test and a CogAT-style screener practice.
- [Test by test guide](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/tests/): what is on the CogAT, NNAT3, NGAT and OLSAT and which practice matches each.
- [Mock test](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/mock-test/): online practice test: quick check (12 questions), CogAT-style screener (3 × 8), NNAT-style shape test (24 questions / 15 minutes or 48 questions / 30 minutes); results by question type, not an official score.
- [Picture Analogies](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/picture-analogies/): Picture analogies show two pictures that go together (bird → nest). Your child finds the picture that goes with a third picture in the same way (bee → hive). They appear in the CogAT Verbal Battery for kindergarten to grade 2, where children choose from 3 pictures and nothing has to be read.
- [Picture Classification](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/picture-classification/): Picture classification shows three pictures that belong to the same group. Your child picks the answer that belongs to that group too. The trick is to find the narrowest group: not just “animals” but “animals that live in water”. It is part of the CogAT Verbal Battery at kindergarten to grade 2.
- [Sentence Completion (Listen & Pick)](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/sentence-completion/): In sentence completion the child listens to a short question, such as “Which one do we use to cut paper?”, and picks the picture that answers it. It tests listening and everyday word knowledge. It is part of the CogAT Verbal Battery at kindergarten to grade 2. Tap Read to me to hear each question.
- [Picture Odd One Out](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/picture-odd-one-out/): Odd one out shows six pictures. Five share one idea and one does not. Your child finds the picture that does not belong. This is the format of the NGAT Verbal test, and the same thinking is used in OLSAT-style classification.
- [Number Analogies](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/number-analogies/): Number analogies show a 2×2 set of boxes with groups of objects. The first pair changes by a number rule (3 → 4: one more). Your child uses the same rule on the bottom row. It is part of the CogAT Quantitative Battery at kindergarten to grade 2 and is one of the three subtests in many short CogAT screeners.
- [Number Puzzles](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/number-puzzles/): Number puzzles ask for the missing number that makes both sides equal, such as 4 = 2 + ? or 1 + 3 = ? + 2. Younger children see it as two trains that must carry the same number. It is part of the CogAT Quantitative Battery.
- [Number Series (Bead Patterns)](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/number-series/): Number series shows rods with beads, like an abacus. The number of beads follows a pattern (2, 4, 6…). Your child picks the rod that comes next. It is the picture form of the CogAT Number Series subtest for young children.
- [Number Patterns](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/number-patterns/): Number patterns show a row or a grid of numbers that follow a rule. Your child finds the rule and the missing number. This matches the NGAT Quantitative test and the CogAT Number Series subtest from grade 3.
- [Figure Matrices](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/figure-matrices/): Figure matrices show four boxes. The top shape changes into the next one by a rule (it changes color, turns, gets bigger, or there are more of them). Your child applies the same rule to the bottom row. It is part of the CogAT Nonverbal Battery and is very close to NNAT “reasoning by analogy”.
- [Paper Folding](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/paper-folding/): In paper folding a square paper is folded once or twice, then a hole is punched or a shape is cut. Your child picks how the paper looks when it is opened. Every fold doubles the holes and mirrors them across the fold line. It is part of the CogAT Nonverbal Battery.
- [Figure Classification](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/figure-classification/): Figure classification shows three shapes that share a rule, such as “all have three sides” or “all are striped”. Your child chooses the shape that follows the same rule. It is part of the CogAT Nonverbal Battery.
- [Pattern Completion](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/pattern-completion/): Pattern completion shows a large design with a missing piece. Your child picks the piece that fits exactly. It is the main question type for young children on the NNAT3, which uses only shapes in blue, yellow, green, black and white and gives five choices.
- [Serial Reasoning](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/serial-reasoning/): Serial reasoning shows a 3×3 grid of shapes that change from row to row and column to column. Your child finds the shape for the empty box. It is one of the NNAT3 question types and appears in NGAT Nonverbal matrices.
- [Spatial Visualization](https://tamakalagames.com/brainosaur/prep/spatial-visualization/): Spatial visualization asks your child to picture shapes in the mind: two shapes put on top of each other, or a shape that is turned. Your child picks how the result looks. It is the hardest NNAT3 question type and is used more at the older levels.
